whyItMatters: An unknown or absent licence class leaves the redistribution question unanswered, which matters for every packaged build. This rule reads a pom.xml with no `<licenses>` block.
actions: Record the licence class the project actually ships under, or stop depending on the component until it is known. Specifically: fix a pom.xml with no `<licenses>` block.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm pom.xml no longer carries a pom.xml with no `<licenses>` block.
